cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 67% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.17%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.22%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.87%, GEV +4.93%, TLN +4.32%, PWR +4.06%, VRT +3.24%. Laggards: ENPH -3.99%, SEDG -3.96%, EQT -3.09%, FSLR -2.11%.
